content: Better a wise and honorable enemy than an ignorant and foolish friend.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Doshman-e dana beh az doost-e nadan (دشمن دانا به از دوست نادان)
explanation: A wise enemy keeps your vigilance sharp, acts with predictable rules of honor, and exposes your blind spots. But an undisciplined, foolish friend, while full of sweet intentions, will unwittingly drop a boulder on your head while trying to swat a fly. Choose companions with discernment.
practicalInsight: Do not surround yourself with yes-men whose foolish loyalty flatters you toward disaster. Seek principled truth.
reflectionPrompt: Who in your inner circle means well, but constantly pulls your life toward drama, carelessness, or foolish choices?
